frd.goal: add Glossary as a new configuration type with CRUD, versioning, prompt substitution, and agent export/import

usecase.post: list of all glossaries returned with id, version, and terms
usecase.step: client sends GET /glossarystore/glossaries
system retrieves all glossary resources
system returns list of glossaries with id, version, terms

usecase.post: new glossary created with version 1 and supplied terms
usecase.step: client sends POST /glossarystore/glossaries with terms as key-value object
system validates each term key against pattern ^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$
system creates glossary resource with id, version 1, and terms
system returns the created glossary

ext.outcome: glossary creation rejected, client receives validation error for an invalid term key

usecase.pre: glossary with the given id exists
usecase.post: glossary updated with new terms and incremented version
usecase.step: client sends PUT /glossarystore/glossaries/{id} with updated terms
system validates each term key against pattern ^[a-z0-9_]{1,64}$
system increments version by one and updates terms
system returns the updated glossary

ext.outcome: glossary update rejected during key validation, client receives error for an invalid term key
update ignored, client receives response indicating the glossary does not exist

usecase.pre: glossary with the given id exists
usecase.post: glossary deleted and no longer accessible
usecase.step: client sends DELETE /glossarystore/glossaries/{id}
system removes the glossary resource
system confirms deletion

ext.outcome: deletion ignored, client receives response indicating no glossary exists at that id

usecase.goal: resolve glossary terms in prompt template
usecase.pre: agent configuration has one or more glossaries bound and prompt contains glossary substitution placeholders
usecase.post: all bound glossary placeholders resolved to their term values, last-loaded glossary wins on key conflicts
usecase.step: system collects all glossaries bound to the agent via agent config references
system verifies each bound glossary still exists
system iterates glossaries in configuration set order and builds a resolved map where later glossaries override earlier ones for duplicate keys
system renders the prompt by resolving each glossary placeholder to its value or leaving unresolved placeholders as-is
system returns the rendered prompt

ext.outcome: prompt rendering fails with HTTP 422 because a bound glossary was deleted
unresolved placeholders remain as-is in the rendered output because the key exists in no bound glossary

usecase.goal: include glossaries in agent export archive
usecase.pre: agent has one or more glossaries bound via configuration
usecase.post: all bound glossaries exported to ZIP as JSON and descriptor files
usecase.step: system iterates all glossaries bound to the agent
system writes each glossary as id.glossary.json and id.descriptor.json into the ZIP archive
system returns the completed ZIP archive

usecase.goal: import glossaries with agent and merge by resource URI
usecase.pre: import ZIP contains glossary data and descriptor files
usecase.post: existing glossaries upgraded, new glossaries created, all bound to agent
usecase.step: system reads glossary files from the import ZIP
system checks whether a glossary with the same resource URI already exists
if a match exists, system upgrades the existing glossary with the imported version and terms; otherwise system creates a new glossary
system binds the glossaries to the imported agent configuration
